selection: Retain the full finite format sweep including every repetition, rejected arm, baseline, population and staged footprint. A layout comparison would be misleading if only minima or winning cells survived. Bulky binary/disassembly/source remain in the native recovery archive.
limitations: Single-writer exclusive-owner format comparison; no concurrent-writer visibility, MVCC publication, DRAM or Loom prefetch result.

All formats hold logical content, seeds, bucket counts and 128-byte units constant. Cardinality derives from legacy power-of-two capacity. Denser recipes therefore run at lower own load factor; this does not compare each format at its own capacity.

The cases are K8..64, set/map/multimap, A6/A10 except K8 A6 only; map/multimap payloads are 8 bytes. The common 16-selector window is unchanged across platforms; no platform-optimal selector or complete payload-size claim.

One fresh process per case/arm in a fixed shuffled order, nine repetitions with a fresh Pool each. Read phases have a complete untimed matching read warmup. Fresh processes/Pool avoid cross-arm pool reuse but do not isolate process placement, machine drift or Abseil randomized seed effects. Nine within-process repetitions are descriptive, not independent machine trials.

Direct arms replace bucket-field primitive operations only. Hashing, routing, headers, chains and owner remain common. legacy/pow2_direct additionally changes list_view to recipe_view; it is not solely a codec comparison.

Duplicate physical recipes are negative controls, not distinct formats. Equal normalized complete read helper instructions can still have different process/address placement. Ratios are observations, not causality or preset selections.

Abseil ordinary and exact-key owners reserve the known cardinality; reserve is charged in construct. MM uses InlinedVector<word,1>, includes full bag values in hit and serial consumption, and appends one value/key in update.
Lifecycle is the sum of separately timed construct/build/update/erase/release, excludes queries, inventory, correctness and Pool setup/drain. It is not uninterrupted lifetime throughput.

Independent hit/miss expected values are checked per key; the serial cycle is separately proved to visit all keys and return to its start. Sets include a caller-provided dependency; maps/MM use value-derived dependencies and MM XORs every value.
K8 is a fixed hierarchy case and bypasses a practical low-occupancy compact-list policy. Its excessive memory ratio must not be read as a recommended representation.

Requested bytes, owned allocation capacity and owner metadata are separate inventories; logical bytes here means requested+metadata. Baseline physical backing is unknown (CSV0 sentinel), not measured as zero. Neither transient peaks nor RSS/cache residence are established.

construct/build/read memory census is after build; update census is after update; erase/release/lifecycle census is after erase. build_primary_rows/secondary_rows/overflow_rows always describe build population, even in later phase rows.
Host feature sets differ together with microarchitecture: Zen5 AVX2 x86-64-v3, Granite native AVX-512, V2 NEON. This campaign cannot separate ISA gains from hardware differences.

Codegen audit follows complete timed CFG through hit/miss/serial/erase, then inventories full direct loop-helper callees. It establishes fusion/call boundaries, not runtime branch frequencies or a cycle model. No hardware profile or PMU causal claim.

codegen.candidate_read_fusion: Lookup and complete value consumer fuse inside the timed interval or one whole-read-loop helper. Cold format-initialization/exception calls remain. No per-key lookup or per-value callback remains.
codegen.erase_boundary: Candidate record_table::erase remains a per-key direct call; MM additionally has an outlined preflight/bag-release continuation. Baseline find is fused but Abseil metadata erase/deallocation calls remain.
codegen.normalization: Helper hashes retain opcode, registers, instruction order and internal NOPs. Branch targets normalize to local instruction indices or demangled symbols; x86 RIP displacement normalizes to its target symbol. Unequal hashes do not prove semantically different code. Equal hashes do not equate runtime placement.
